externalEntryPoints.function: dispatch(address minter, uint256 amount, bytes extraData)
externalEntryPoints.flow: calls _dispatch(...) override then hook.onDispatch(minter, amount, extraData)

externalEntryPoints.function: pool(uint256 minPairOut, uint256 minTargetOut, uint256 minLP)
externalEntryPoints.flow: swap all prime->pair (router), swap half pair->target, addLiquidity(target,pair). LP accrues here as POL.
externalEntryPoints.valueFlow: prime in (held balance) -> LP tokens out (held on dispatcher)

externalEntryPoints.validation: len>=2, starts at prime, ends at current pairToken

externalEntryPoints.note: NOT pause-gated (escape hatch); also LP-withdrawal mechanism

externalCalls.notes: assumed standard ERC20; FOT handled upstream by minter (amount is FOT-adjusted)
owner-configured at deploy; deadline=block.timestamp (no real deadline protection)
owner-settable via setPool; only read for token derivation
base default is DefaultDispatchHook (NO-OP, zero debt). Uniboost does NOT enforce hookTypeId.

localInvariants: hook is never zero (base seeds DefaultDispatchHook; setHook rejects zero) -> dispatch is branch-free
_dispatch must NOT re-declare onlyMinter/whenNotPaused/nonReentrant (they live on base dispatch) - verified compliant
donationAmount = enabled ? amount*donationSplit/100 : 0; donationSplit<=100 invariant enforced in setter
pool() carves prime balance entirely; whatever prime remains after dispatch's donation is the pool() basis
_pairToken is always the pool's non-target token (derived in _setPool; requires targetToken in pool)
trustAssumptions: Prime token is standard ERC20; FOT adjustment already applied by NFTMinterV2 before passing amount
Router and pool are honest UniV2 (owner-configured); pool() is permissioned to authorized poolers who choose slippage floors
Owner is trusted to wire the correct mint-debt hook via setHook (NO on-chain hookTypeId enforcement - see red flags)
Owner sets donation recipient correctly (intended: BalancerPooler batch-minter)

hookWiring.invocation: base ATokenDispatcherV2.dispatch -> hook.onDispatch(minter, amount, extraData) with GROSS amount (pre-donation)
hookWiring.hookTypeIdEnforcement: NONE. Uniboost._dispatch performs no hookTypeId()==EXPECTED check, unlike NudgeRatchet (post-M-04, line 86-89).
hookWiring.defaultHook: DefaultDispatchHook (NO-OP). If owner never calls setHook to wire UniboostMintDebtHook, every dispatch accrues ZERO phUSD debt and tests of the dispatcher in isolation pass silently.
hookWiring.donationVsDebt: Debt accrues on GROSS dispatched amount even though donationSplit% is forwarded to recipient. Same convention as BalancerPoolerV2 (documented). Scanners should confirm the donation forward + debt-on-gross does not double-count/under-back phUSD across the two-leg system.

redFlagsForScanners: HOOK-WIRING (echoes prior M-04): Uniboost does NOT enforce hookTypeId on its hook. NudgeRatchet was fixed in story-037 to require INudgeRatchetMintDebtHook(hook).hookTypeId()==EXPECTED_HOOK_TYPE_ID inside _dispatch. Uniboost/UniboostMintDebtHook expose NO hookTypeId at all, so the M-04 unwired/wrong-hook -> zero-debt footgun is structurally re-openable here. Flag for code-scanner/story-faithfulness.
router deadline = block.timestamp on every swap/addLiquidity = no deadline protection (relies on minPairOut/minTargetOut/minLP floors chosen by pooler).
addLiquidity called with amountAMin=0, amountBMin=0; slippage relies solely on the two upstream swap floors + post-call minLP require. Confirm minLP alone is sufficient sandwich/JIT protection.

setPool can be repointed after primeToPairPath was validated against the OLD _pairToken; path is not re-validated on setPool -> stale path could end at wrong token. setPrimeToPairPath validates end==_pairToken at set-time only.
rescueERC20 is owner escape hatch AND the LP-withdrawal mechanism; not pause-gated by design. (Owner trusted; note for completeness.)
pool() leaves residual dust (refunded addLiquidity side); swept by next pool(). Benign but note value-accounting.
